abstracts.abstract: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of transportation to grant a perpetual conservation easement to certain entities over certain state-owned lands in the hamlets of Setauket and Port Jefferson Station, Suffolk County.

bill.title: Authorizes and directs the conveyance of a conservation easement over certain state-owned lands in the hamlets of Setauket and Port Jefferson Station, Suffolk County

posted_text:
🌲 NY A10341 — Your town could protect a vital green space

A conservation easement will permanently protect a scenic greenway corridor in Setauket and Port Jefferson Station, preserving tree canopy and trails.

July 6, 2026: Signed Chap.164.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.nysenate.gov/legislation/bills/2025/A10341
